leakage_findings: Completed-bar primitives exist, but required new 12x5m and 8x15m builders are absent.
Current IB is 09:30–10:29 and must be unavailable before 10:30.
Old builder has six Fibonacci extensions only; full level set/contract must be frozen.
Moving walls require exact as-of identity per token; no floor, deduplication, nearest or inferred timestamp.
Existing executable-quote labels are 30m/stop/trailing and lack exact fixed 24 payoffs; they cannot be reused without a new frozen payoff contract.
Phase-1 event key must include ticker/date/decision/expiration/right/strike/delta/entry quote timestamp/exit quote timestamp.
Chronological reject_while_open exists and is required.
Monthly feature→freeze→outer barrier exists; independent audit must reimplement rather than import evaluator.
